tools.name: deploy_html
tools.description: Deploy one HTML document and get back a live, unguessable https://<slug>.shipped.page/ URL. Anonymous: 10 deploys/min per IP, 10MB body cap, 7-day expiry. Pro ($4/mo): custom or no TTL, named drops.

tools.name: deploy_files
tools.description: Deploy a map of path -> content as a multi-file site (must include index.html to serve at the root). Anonymous: up to 100 files per request, 7-day expiry (30 days once signed in). Pro ($4/mo): up to 900 files, custom or no TTL, named drops.

tools.name: append_files
tools.description: Add files to a drop owned by the authenticated account (requires an sp_ API key and an active subscription): up to 900 files per call, 10,000 per drop total, and existing paths are overwritten. The drop keeps its current expiry.

tools.name: list_drops
tools.description: List drops owned by the authenticated account (requires an sp_ API key; anonymous drops are not listable). Returns slug, url, name, file counts, and expiry, newest first.

tools.name: claim_drop
tools.description: Attach an anonymously deployed drop to the authenticated account using its one-time claim token (spc_..., returned once by deploy_html/deploy_files). Claiming extends the drop to the free-account lifetime (30 days) and can revive an expired drop that is still inside its claimable window (anonymous d

tools.name: restore_drop
tools.description: Bring back an expired drop owned by the authenticated account while its files are still retained (requires an sp_ API key). Free accounts restore up to 30 days past expiry and the drop comes back at the 30-day lifetime; paid plans restore up to 90 days past expiry and the drop never expires again.

tools.name: delete_drop
tools.description: Permanently delete a drop owned by the authenticated account (requires an sp_ API key). The URL stops serving immediately and cannot be recovered.

tools.name: get_limits
tools.description: Show the ship.page plan matrix (anonymous free tier vs Pro $4/mo vs Team $19/mo) and, when an sp_ API key is present, the caller's current account/plan status.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Show the authenticated account's plan, subscription status and usage (requires an sp_ API key). Anonymous callers should use get_limits for the static free-tier limits.
